main is 38 commits past v4.0.2.1, one more than the packet init snapshot recorded; the extra commit is 3c15d3fde6a chore(system-spec-kit): rebuild the trigger index, so init-time HEAD ee7a2087ade is stale.

No root CHANGELOG.md or CHANGELOG exists. Root markdown is AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, INSTALL-SKILLED.md, PUBLIC-RELEASE.md, README.md, SECURITY.md; changelog matches are per-packet files under specs/ plus the command doc .skilled/commands/create/changelog.md.
Release notes live at .skilled/changelog/<skill>/<version>.md; the root release document is .skilled/changelog/skilled/v4.0.2.1.md at 516 lines.

v4.0.2.1 requires patched Node.js 22.23.4, 24.22.1 or 26.12.1; Node 20/23/25 are rejected by nine package manifests, though no package sets engine-strict so npm only warns. Code Mode requires >=24.22.1 <25.0.0.
The v4.0.2.1 notes name eight supported runtimes: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin, OpenCode, Pi, DSH and Mistral Vibe. This is the authoritative count for the README support matrix.

v4.0.2.1 renames session relaunch to session handover: hook folder .skilled/hooks/session-handover/, switch SYSTEM_SESSION_HANDOVER_ENABLED, state folder .skilled/skills/.state/session-handover/, Claude Code on by default, other runtimes off. Old SYSTEM_SESSION_RELAUNCH_* switches are no longer read.
The AI Council left Deep Loop: /deep:ai-council is gone and /speckit:ai-council replaces it. Deep-loop stop decisions are now computed by a script, not judged by the model.
The skill advisor now names the command behind a hub skill and attaches a run/start/ask policy covering 44 tracked commands, e.g. 'use system-spec-kit -> /speckit:plan (start)'.

The 38 post-tag commits cluster into five workstreams: cross-runtime handover parity, Mistral Vibe hardening, hook-library cleanup from worktree 411, deep-loop review verdict work, and trigger-index rebuild churn.

The hook library on main is post-cleanup: 1c88ed62854 removes dead files, renames folders literally and rewrites READMEs; 3fd4e4bdf1a imports each Pi hook core once from its own folder. Any README hook table built from pre-tag paths is wrong on folder names.
The v4.0.2.1 tag was moved: commit c951a23b975 records the move and the tag object 06037dee3da is dated the morning of this run, so a stated release date must use the final tag object date.
Release notes for this repository live under .skilled/changelog/<skill>/<version>.md; there is no root changelog to link from README.md.
The README support matrix must enumerate eight runtimes, matching the v4.0.2.1 notes rather than any earlier six- or seven-runtime list.
